title: Ryan Garret Conner: three typefaces on one screen of IBM blue
note: Full-screen #0000ff. One centred block of three lines: a pixelated blackletter-ish name, ©2026 // DIGITAL PORTFOLIO in a grotesk, ART DIRECTOR ✦ DIRECTOR in a pixel serif, with sparkles and a hairline. The project list sits right under it in tiny two-column type, grouped by client. Worth taking: a palette of one colour, and type mixing that clashes on purpose.
